第二章爷爷发现，最终支持

哭声戛然而止，闫嫣有不好的预感，目光却落在爸妈身上。

“哼，别看他们，我是在问你。”

老爷子态度很强硬，闫嫣知道瞒不住了，艰难起身，撸袖子卷裤腿。

“爷奶，大伯大伯母你们看，这就是顾城妈亲手打的。从我嫁过去到现在五个月，你们看看我身上有多少伤，连怀孕都没停过手。”

“是啊爸，昨天嫣嫣回来后就肚子疼，本来还没在意，结果到医院检查才知道孩子根本保不住，所以干脆给打干净，一了百了。”

魏淑萍可不管老爷子发现了什么，反正孩子没了，无论如何顾老太婆就得担起此大罪。

“我的乖宝，奶当初咋就给你选个狼窝，我疼了十八年的孙女却去别人家挨打受罪。

死老头你问什么问，嫣嫣的伤能作假，你到底在怀疑什么？”

闫老头后背被拍了好几巴掌，最终叹口气把有些话给咽了下去。今早他可是亲眼看见孙女好好的走出家门的，怎么可能去了趟县城孩子就没了。

“罢了，爷爷不问了，嫣嫣你是咋想的。”

“爷奶，我实话实说，嫁过去五个月，我的嫁妆在第二天就被抢走了，下地干活后还要伺候一家洗衣做饭，甚至连大伯哥和小姑子的裤衩都要洗。

婆婆一个不顺心就是非打即骂，顾城更过分，他明明把一切看在眼里却不闻不问，我找他哭他还说谁家媳妇不是这样过日子。

爷奶，我不想过这样的日子，也实在撑不住了，我疼，我很累，如果不能彻底离开顾家那我就去死！”

闫嫣说的发自内心，不管原主是如何能忍下的，反正她接收了记忆就不能多忍一秒。

闫解放气愤的把茶缸都给摔了，他闫家人啥时候被欺负成这样了。

“嫣嫣，你受欺负为什么没回家说，为什么等到孩子保不住才开口。

你的心眼长哪里去了，平日里见你在家可是能打能闹，到了婆家就能成软蛋了是吧。”

“你骂嫣嫣干什么，她是嫁人了，哪个结了婚的姑娘能轻易回娘家哭诉的，那是咱嫣嫣懂事。”

Chapter 2 Grandpa discovers and finally supports

The crying stopped suddenly. Yan Yan had a bad feeling, but her eyes fell on her parents.

"Hmph, don't look at them, I'm asking you."

The old man's attitude was very tough, and Yan Yan knew she couldn't hide it any more, so she got up with difficulty, rolled up her sleeves and trouser legs.

"Grandma, uncles and aunts, look, this was done by Gu Cheng's mother herself. It's been five months since I got married, and you can see how many injuries I have on my body. I didn't stop even when I was pregnant."

"Yes, Dad, Yanyan had a stomachache after she came back yesterday. I didn't pay much attention to it at first, but when I went to the hospital for a checkup, I found out that the baby couldn't be saved at all, so I just gave it a clean and the whole thing was over."

Wei Shuping didn't care what the old man discovered, since the child was gone anyway, Old Lady Gu would have to bear this serious crime anyway.

"My dear baby, why did I choose a wolf den for you in the first place, but my granddaughter, who I have loved for eighteen years, went to someone else's house to be beaten and tortured?

What are you asking, old man? Yanyan's injuries can be faked. What are you doubting?"

Old Man Yan was slapped on the back several times, and finally sighed and swallowed some of his words.This morning he saw his granddaughter walking out of the house well. How could he go to the county town and then the child disappear.

"That's all, grandpa, I won't ask anymore, Yanyan, what do you think?"

"Grandma, I'll tell you the truth. Five months after I got married, my dowry was taken away the next day. After working in the fields, I had to wait for the family to do laundry and cooking. I even had to wash my eldest brother and sister-in-law's underwear.

Whenever my mother-in-law didn't get her way, she would hit or scold her. Gu Cheng was even more outrageous. He clearly saw everything but turned a blind eye. When I asked him to cry, he even said that some daughter-in-law didn't live like this.

Grandma, I don’t want to live like this, and I really can’t hold on any longer. I feel pain and I’m very tired. If I can’t leave the Gu family completely, then I’ll die!"

Yan Yan spoke from the bottom of her heart. No matter how the original owner could bear it, she couldn't bear it for one more second after receiving the memory.

Yan Jiefang was so angry that he threw the teapot. When had his Yan family been bullied like this?

“Yanyan, why didn’t you go home and tell your story when you were bullied? Why didn’t you speak until you couldn’t save your child?

Where are your thoughts? On weekdays, you can fight and make trouble at home, but when you go to your husband's house, you become a softie, right?"

"Why are you scolding Yanyan? She is married. No married girl can easily go back to her parents' home and cry. That's because we, Yanyan, are sensible."
